title: Bramble – Local-first password manager
claim: Show HN: Bramble – Local-first password manager
why_good: Bramble's local-first approach addresses growing privacy concerns, appealing to users wary of cloud-based solutions.
value: Users could pay for premium features like advanced encryption or cross-device syncing, while businesses might subscribe for team management tools.
risk: The market is crowded with established players, and user acquisition could be challenging if they don't clearly differentiate their offering.
